live_smoke.question: As of FY2023Q1, by how many percentage points did Pepsico raise full year guidance in respect of core constant currency EPS growth?
live_smoke.answer: Pepsico raised full-year guidance for core constant currency EPS growth by **1 percentage point** to 9 percent. This represents an increase from the previously expected 8 percent (Source: PEPSICO_2023Q1_EARNINGS, page 3).
live_smoke.reference_answer: Pepsico raised full year guidance in respect of core constant currency EPS growth by 1 percentage point.
